title: Forward Propagation — One Batch, One Ordered Computation
key_insight: For a dense layer, the batch matrix multiplies the weight matrix, receives a bias, and passes through an activation. The output becomes the next layer’s input.
body:
## One Batch, One Ordered Computation

Processing one example at a time wastes the hardware’s ability to work on many rows together. A batch groups examples into one tensor.

For a dense layer, the batch matrix multiplies the weight matrix, receives a bias, and passes through an activation. The output becomes the next layer’s input.

During training, the framework also remembers needed intermediate values. During inference, that saved trail is unnecessary and can be disabled.
common_mistakes: A forward pass updates every weight before producing output.
Batches must contain exactly one example.
Evaluation mode randomly removes more units than training mode.

real_world_usage: Every training step and every real prediction begins with a correct forward pass.
